items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I went with Stuffy Smith and played Chicago, and after Chicago I went with Stuff Smith to Hollywood... with Stuff Smith, and Buddy Rich, and all of us, did a jam session out there

ctx.x: Over the years, were you with Fats's group right to the end of the thing?
Well, yes and no. I'll tell you why I said that, because I had stopped -- I had left Fats to go with well, maybe Stuff Smith. I was with Stuff for a while.
